source.lore: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.

lore_i18n.en: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.
lore_i18n.ru: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.
lore_i18n.zh-cn: 出价购得的珍贵之物，卖家是厄泽王庭本来并不起眼的统治者，他放弃自己的王位后消失得无影无踪。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 出價購得的珍貴之物，賣家是厄澤王庭本來並不起眼的統治者，他放棄自己的王位後消失得無影無蹤。
